say: In assess, check that it is a real problem. Does it recur? How many incidents? What impact?

say: Press confirm to start the root cause analysis.

c: Write Cause notes and, as soon as you have one, the Workaround.
say: Record what you learn in the cause notes, and the workaround as soon as you have one.

c: Split the work into problem tasks; only problem task analysts can be assigned.
say: Split the work into problem tasks. Only problem task analysts can be assigned.

c: Completing a root cause analysis task asks for the cause code, cause notes, fix notes and workaround.
say: Completing a root cause analysis task asks for the cause code, the cause notes, the proposed fix, and any workaround.

c: When the last task closes, the coordinator is emailed.
say: When the last task closes, the coordinator is emailed.
